installation.command: vf venv .venv; source .venv/bin/activate; pip install sglang
installation.wheel_provenance: All 207 cached wheel archives matched the SHA256 values in the unconstrained online pip resolution, and all 207 distributions were installed into this new venv.
installation.gpu_test: The same complete venv was mounted read-only at its original path on the V100. Both processes started with empty compiler and driver caches.

method: Identical GPU, venv, model, graph shapes and guide options. Each run used one warm-up and three salted prompts, batch size one, temperature zero. SGLang device timers measured 227 uncached input tokens and the 63 decode steps after the first output token.
